title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person awaiting UPDATE still executes the unguarded update_reference_call_status — mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person is dead code and the race pin is vacuous
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1250-1256: sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated), preceded only by the read-time check case row.taken_over_at != "" { True -> wisp.redirect(...) }. update_reference_call_status.sql:22-23: WHERE id = $1 AND status = $5::reference_call_status (no taken_over_at clause). mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql:27: AND taken_over_at IS NULL — called ONLY from the test (let assert Ok(returned) = rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)); grep shows no server/src call site.
detail: r4 mandate: the executed wrong-person UPDATE must carry the taken_over_at IS NULL backstop. The handler still runs the unguarded UPDATE; a take-over between token read and UPDATE still yanks the row into awaiting_correction. The pin calls the guarded SQL directly — the named vacuous pin.
recommended_fix: Wire mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person into apply_wrong_person's awaiting branch (0 rows -> redirect); replace the direct-SQL pin with a test driving POST /reference/<token>/wrong-person with take-over injected between read and update, asserting the row is never yanked.

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): overflow-menu Escape handler remains on the menu div — the natural click-then-Escape flow still does nothing
evidence: reference_panel.gleam:745-750: // r2 (N14): Escape closes the menu (the confirm_modal pattern). event.on("keydown", menu_escape_decoder(msg.UserToggledRefcheckMenu(call.reference_call_id))), attached to the menu html.div (~742) — a SIBLING of the ... button (html.button with event.on_click at ~716); the menu has no attribute.autofocus and no autofocus exists anywhere in reference_panel.gleam.
detail: After clicking ... the button holds focus; keydown does not bubble from the button to the sibling menu div, so Escape is inert until the user tabs into a menuitem. The r3 N14 audit asked for the handler on the button or autofocus into the menu — neither happened.
recommended_fix: Move the keydown handler onto the ... button (or autofocus the first menuitem when the menu opens) so Escape closes the menu in the click-then-Escape flow.
